items.definition: Bir cümlenin anlamını koruyan yeniden ifadesini seçmeye dayanan sekiz soru.

questions.prompt: Only by cutting costs drastically can the company return to profitability.
options: The company will return to profitability whether or not it cuts costs.
Cutting costs drastically prevents the company from returning to profitability.
The company must return to profitability before it cuts costs.
The company can return to profitability only if it cuts costs drastically.
The company can return to profitability without cutting any costs.
questions.explanationTR: «Only by ...» tek yolu belirtir: maliyetleri ciddi biçimde kısarsa kârlılığa dönebilir: (D). (A) kısıntıyı gereksiz yapar. (B) kısıntıyı engel yapar. (C) sırayı tersine çevirir. (E) kısıntısız da dönebileceğini söyler.

questions.prompt: Much as the residents disliked the plan, they accepted it.
options: The residents accepted the plan because they liked it very much.
The residents disliked the plan because they accepted it.
The residents disliked the plan and therefore refused to accept it.
The residents accepted the plan since they disliked it greatly.
The residents accepted the plan even though they disliked it.
questions.explanationTR: «Much as» karşıtlık kurar: sevmeseler de kabul ettiler: (E). (A) kabulü sevmeye bağlar. (B) neden ve sonucu tersine çevirir. (C) reddettiklerini söyler. (D) sevmemeyi kabul nedeni yapar.

questions.prompt: It is high time the government took action against tax evasion.
options: The government ought to act against tax evasion without further delay.
The government has taken action against tax evasion just in time.
The government took action against tax evasion too early.
The government will take action against tax evasion in the distant future.
The government must not take action against tax evasion yet.
questions.explanationTR: «It is high time ... took» hükümetin artık harekete geçmesi gerektiğini bildirir: (A). (B) zamanında harekete geçtiğini söyler. (C) çok erken davrandığını söyler. (D) uzak geleceğe erteler. (E) harekete geçmemesi gerektiğini söyler.

questions.prompt: The harder she tried, the more frustrated she became.
options: As she tried harder, she became less frustrated.
As she tried harder, she became increasingly frustrated.
She became frustrated because she had not tried hard.
Although she tried hard, she was never frustrated.
The more frustrated she became, the less she tried.
questions.explanationTR: «The harder ..., the more ...» orantılı artıştır: çaba arttıkça hayal kırıklığı arttı: (B). (A) hayal kırıklığını azaltır. (C) nedeni çabasızlığa çevirir. (D) hayal kırıklığını inkâr eder. (E) ilişkiyi tersine çevirir.

questions.prompt: The minister denied having been informed about the plan.
options: The minister admitted having been informed about the plan.
The minister denied informing anyone about the plan.
The minister said that he had not been informed about the plan.
The minister said that he would not be informed about the plan.
The minister refused to inform anyone about the plan.
questions.explanationTR: «Denied having been informed» = haberdar edilmediğini söyledi: (C). (A) haberdar edildiğini kabul eder. (B) ve (E) haber verme eylemine kayar. (D) zamanı geleceğe çevirir.

questions.prompt: Rather than raise taxes, the government decided to cut spending.
options: The government cut spending instead of raising taxes.
The government raised taxes instead of cutting spending.
The government raised taxes and cut spending.
The government cut spending in order to raise taxes.
The government neither raised taxes nor cut spending.
questions.explanationTR: «Rather than» bir seçeneğin yerine diğerini seçmeyi anlatır: vergi artırmak yerine harcama kısıldı: (A). (B) tercihi tersine çevirir. (C) ikisini birden yaptığını söyler. (D) harcama kısmayı vergi artırma amacı yapar. (E) ikisini de yapmadığını söyler.

questions.prompt: Had it not been for the volunteers, the festival would have been cancelled.
options: The festival was cancelled because of the volunteers.
The festival was cancelled although the volunteers helped.
The volunteers cancelled the festival.
The festival went ahead because the volunteers helped.
The volunteers were not needed for the festival to go ahead.
questions.explanationTR: «Had it not been for» gönüllüler olmasaydı iptal olacağını söyler: gönüllüler sayesinde festival yapıldı: (D). (A) iptali gönüllülere bağlar. (B) iptal edildiğini söyler. (C) iptali gönüllülerin yaptığını söyler. (E) gönüllülere gerek olmadığını söyler.

questions.prompt: Scarcely had the meeting begun when the fire alarm rang.
options: The meeting began after the fire alarm had rung.
The fire alarm rang long before the meeting began.
The meeting had almost ended when the fire alarm rang.
The fire alarm rang because the meeting had begun.
The fire alarm rang almost as soon as the meeting began.
questions.explanationTR: «Scarcely ... when» iki olayın art arda gerçekleştiğini anlatır: toplantı başlar başlamaz alarm çaldı: (E). (A) ve (B) sırayı tersine çevirir. (C) toplantının bitmek üzere olduğunu söyler. (D) alarmı toplantıya bağlar.
